newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine weekly official crop progress.
newsitem.headline: Argentine weekly official crop progress.

text.p: Argentine farmers began sowing sunflower in western Entre Rios and northern Santa Fe, the Agriculture Secretariat said Thursday in its weekly crop report, dated September 6.

But a lack of moisture had paralyzed sunflower sowing in Chaco and Santiago del Estero. Long-cycle wheat crops are in good condition and are benefitting from deep soil moisture. They are being helped by plentiful fertilizer. Wheat in Buenos Aires, except in the northwest of the province, and in La Pampa, except in the north, are generally in good shape. But wheat elsewhere needs rain soon or yields will suffer.
